units.source_text: 天明之后，右近退回相识的僧人家休息。

en.t: After daybreak, Ukon went back to the home of a monk she knew to rest.

units.source_text: 这大约是为了便于与乳母等畅谈衷曲。

en.t: This was probably so that she could speak freely and at length with the nurse and the others about what was in her heart.

units.source_text: 玉鬘十分慵困，见人又很怕羞，模样甚是可怜。

en.t: Tamakazura was very weary and languid, and she was shy about meeting people, making her look deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 右近说道：“我因意外之缘，得供职于高贵之家，曾经见过许多名媛淑女。

en.t: Ukon said, "Through an unexpected connection, I came to serve in a noble household, and I have seen many distinguished and refined ladies.

units.source_text: 但每次拜见紫夫人，总觉得其美貌无人能及。

en.t: But whenever I attend upon Lady Murasaki, I always feel that no one can equal her beauty.

units.source_text: 紫夫人所抚育的明石小女公子，肖似父母，相貌自然也很端丽。

en.t: The young Akashi princess raised by Lady Murasaki resembles both her parents, so naturally her looks are also very graceful and beautiful.

units.source_text: 但亦半因大臣夫妇对她爱护异常周至之故。

en.t: Yet that is also partly because the minister and his lady have cared for her with extraordinary attention.

units.source_text: 如今我家玉鬘小姐生长穷乡，又兼旅途劳顿，而容姿依然秀美，不亚于彼等，此诚大可庆喜之事。

en.t: Now our Lady Tamakazura grew up in a poor, remote province and is also worn out from travel, yet her appearance is still elegant and beautiful, no less than theirs, which is truly a great cause for joy.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣从桐壶爷时代以来，看见过许多女御与后妃。

en.t: The Grand Minister Genji has seen many imperial consorts and empresses since the reign of the Kiritsubo Emperor.

units.source_text: 宫中上上下下的女子，他全都见过。

en.t: He has seen all the women of the court, from the highest to the lowest.

units.source_text: 但他说：‘我觉得当今皇上的母亲藤壶母后和我家那个小女公子，相貌最好，所谓美人，正是指这种人。’

en.t: But he says, 'I think the mother of the present emperor, Empress Fujitsubo, and that young princess in my own house have the finest looks. When people speak of beauties, they mean women like them.'

units.source_text: 我想比较一下，可是藤壶母后我不曾见过。

en.t: I would like to compare them, but I have never seen Empress Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 明石小女公子的确长得美丽。

en.t: The young Akashi princess is indeed growing up beautifully.

units.source_text: 然而今年还只八岁，尚未成人，将来是可想而知的。

en.t: However, she is only eight this year and not yet grown, so one can imagine what she will become.

units.source_text: 紫夫人的相貌，哪个赶得上呢？

en.t: But who could ever match Lady Murasaki's appearance?

units.source_text: 源氏大臣也确认她是个优越的美人。

en.t: Lord Genji himself recognizes that she is a beauty beyond compare.

units.source_text: 然而在口上，哪里肯公然将她数入美人之列呢？

en.t: Yet in words, how could he ever openly count her among the great beauties?

units.source_text: 反而同她开玩笑，说‘你嫁给我这美男子是不配的’。

en.t: Instead he jokes with her, saying, 'You are not worthy to be married to such a handsome man as I am.'

units.source_text: 我看了这许多美人，真可消灾延寿！

en.t: Seeing so many beauties has truly felt as if it could dispel misfortune and lengthen my life!

units.source_text: 我以为世界上更没有比得上她们的美人了。

en.t: I thought there could be no beauties in the world who could compare with them.

units.source_text: 岂知我们这玉鬘小姐，竟处处不比她们逊色。

en.t: Yet who would have known that our Lady Tamakazura would prove inferior to them in no respect at all?

units.source_text: 世事都有极限，无论怎样优越的美人，总不会像佛菩萨那样顶上发出圆光。

en.t: Everything in the world has its limits, and however exceptional a beauty may be, she will never shine with a halo above her head like a buddha or bodhisattva.

units.source_text: 我家小姐的玉貌，可说是达到美人的极限了。”

en.t: The jewel-like beauty of our young lady may be said to have reached the very limit of human beauty."

units.source_text: 她说到这里，满面笑容地注视玉鬘。

en.t: Having said this, she looked at Tamakazura with a smile spread across her face.
